name: Pedro
description: Pedro (Cinch, High Five) is an American Pitch variant. The trump 5 (pedro) and the other 5 of same colour (low pedro) are each worth 5 points. 4p partnerships, 9 cards each, bidding 7-14. Discard non-trumps, refill to 6. First to 62 wins.

overview.description: Pedro (Cinch, High Five) is an American Pitch variant. The trump 5 (pedro) and the other 5 of same colour (low pedro) are each worth 5 points. 4p partnerships, 9 cards each, bidding 7-14. Discard non-trumps, refill to 6. First to 62 wins.

history.origins: US 19th-century Pitch variant. Very popular late 1800s; declined in 20th century. Still played in southern USA, West Coast, Louisiana, Nicaragua (as Pedro), Finland (Pidro), Italy, Azores.
timeline: Present: Southern USA, Louisiana, Nicaragua, Finland.
history.evolution: Variants: Pedro Sancho, Dom Pedro, Snoozer, King Pedro, 63, 83.

setup.dealing: 9 each, 3 at a time. Deal and play clockwise.

rules.objective: Bid 7-14; choose trump; win at least bid points. First to 62 wins.
rules.gameplay: 1. Bidding: one chance each, min 7 max 14. Dealer forced to bid 7 if all pass. 2. High bidder names trump. 3. All discard non-trumps. Dealer fills others to 6; dealer takes trumps from remainder (may have >6). 4. High bidder leads. 5. Trump rank: A-K-Q-J-10-9-8-7-5(pedro)-other 5(low pedro)-4-3-2. 6. Points: high(1), jack(1), ten(1), pedro(5), low pedro(5), low(1) = 14 total. Trump 2 point goes to holder's team.
keyRules: Pedro = trump 5 (5 pts). Low pedro = other 5 same colour (5 pts).
Bid 7-14. Must make bid or subtract from score.
Discard non-trumps; refill to 6. Dealer takes all trumps.
62 to win. Bidder goes out when both 55+.

strategy.basic: Cinch: trump with high card to stop pedro. Save scoring trumps.
strategy.intermediate: Bid according to trump strength. Bury non-scoring trumps.
strategy.advanced: Count points. Coordinate with partner via play.
tips: Trump 2 point goes to holder's team regardless.
Slam (14) scores 28 if made, -14 if set (variant).
